Initially, I had a case of gout in my ankle - absolute agony. This went untreated for over 3 weeks. I was told I couldn't have the traditional medicine, so would need to attend the surgery for an appointment. I couldn't walk, lived on my own, and could not get there. As a result, no treatment as no alternatives were offered.

Once the gout eased off, I had a different pain. The GP ignored my comments that this wasn't gout and continually sent me for the same tests, not believing me. In frustration, I paid to see a podiatrist, have an MRI scan, and see a specialist - costing me nearly £1000. The specialist said the problem was obvious - I had a cavity in my ankle joint which required surgery. Eventually, I had this done and recovered well.

Since then, I've repeatedly been called in for blood tests that turned out to be unnecessary, and "annual reviews" that had taken place a few months earlier. Nevertheless, when I needed to see somebody, an appointment was impossible. I had horrendous back pain 2 months ago, and could hardly get out of bed for 2 weeks. It was the third instance in 3 months, but the worst by far. I completed the online questionnaire, but was refused a GP appointment. I was put on a waiting list for physio.

After over 50 years under this practice, I've left. I no longer have faith in the staff or systems.
